Anchor in cash-generative software with clear AI monetization (Copilot) and complement with networking beneficiaries of AI data center buildouts. Add a measured allocation to the leading GPU supplier to capture upside from sustained AI compute demand, sized conservatively given valuation sensitivity, export-control risks, and episodic rate-driven volatility. Emphasize quality balance sheets, consistent beats, and positive analyst consensus. Reassess position sizes on rate spikes (>5% 10Y), regulatory shocks, or signs of AI capex digestion.
